# Authentik · identity control plane
One view of SSO request health, protected-app proxy traffic, worker queues, pod resources, and the two-node CloudNativePG PostgreSQL database. Green status cards show the expected live replicas. PostgreSQL panels depend on the metrics NetworkPolicy path. **Authentik 2026.5.6** · refresh 1m · all data stays inside the cluster.
